propertySets.name: Pset_ImpactProtectionDeviceOccurrenceBumper
propertySets.definition: Properties common to all occurrences of IfcImpactProtectionDevice with PredefinedType set to BUMPER.

properties.name: BrakingLength
properties.definition: Length of the braking distance as a design parameter of the bumper occurrence.

properties.name: IsRemovableBumper
properties.definition: Indicates if the bumper is removable or not.

properties.name: BumperOrientation
properties.definition: Direction in which the bumper is aligned, e.g. same direction as increasing stationing values or opposite.

propertySets.name: Pset_ImpactProtectionDeviceTypeBumper
propertySets.definition: Properties common to all occurrences and types of IfcImpactProtectionDevice with PredefinedType set to BUMPER.

properties.name: IsAbsorbingEnergy
properties.definition: Indicates whether the bumper absorbs energy or not.

properties.name: EnergyAbsorption
properties.definition: Energy absorption capacity of the element.
